summary: Moves the public embed endpoints (GET api/embeds/{embed}/{options}, POST api/embed-options) out of the 10-per-minute login throttle group into their own 60-per-minute 'embeds' bucket, and gives the embed stream route the same separate bucket, so embed traffic no longer uses up (or is blocked by) the login rate limit.

statements.why: Embed routes were already public (outside the auth group) before; only the rate-limit bucket and ceiling change. No new exposure.

statements.text: The agent changed routes/api.base.php and routes/web.base.php in ways plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what they do differently.
statements.why: True but says nothing about what changed.

misses.what: Embedded players no longer share the login rate limit: before, loading embeds counted against the same 10-requests-per-minute-per-visitor limit as sign-in (so embeds got blocked and could lock people out of logging in); now embeds get their own 60-per-minute limit.
